title: FOURIER ART
shortDescription: Turn photos into Fourier drawing animations and export PNG, GIF or MP4.
fullDescription:
Explore how a drawing takes shape through Fourier series and epicycles.

Choose a photo or take a new one, adjust the crop and review its contours before animating them. Clean up lines, erase segments and add strokes by hand. You can also start with a demonstration shape.

Adjust Fourier components, playback speed, colors and epicycle visibility. Zoom in and export a PNG image, animated GIF or silent MP4 video, using a square or vertical frame. Save the file or share it with other apps.

• Camera and Android image picker.
• Auto, Subject and Drawing profiles.
• Cropping, rotation and contour correction.
• Playback, pause and manual seeking.
• English and Spanish interface.
• No account, ads or in-app purchases.

Results depend on the photo, background and contrast. Some images need contour corrections; faithful reproduction of every photograph is not guaranteed. The Subject profile may need a model download through Google Play services. Drawing works without that model.

Photos are processed on your device. Google SDKs may transmit technical metrics and identifiers for diagnostics and usage analytics; see the privacy policy.
